optionName: Prebuild inventory before the maintenance window
summary: Raise utilisation to 90 percent at 90 percent rate during the prebuild period only, and let the maintenance window proceed as scheduled.
materialsConstraint: Requires 8 percent additional pump-cap supply in the prebuild period; supplier confirmed.
rejectionReason: Delivers only 80960 of the 100000 committed incremental units.

optionName: Move part of production to alternate line PKG-05
summary: Qualify PKG-05 for Hydration Sunscreen and move part of the volume there while the maintenance window proceeds.
effectOnExistingOrders: Displaces 12000 units of Skin Health volume on PKG-05.
materialsConstraint: Requires a dedicated changeover kit and a second filling head.
rejectionReason: PKG-05 is not qualified for Sun Care. Qualification takes an estimated 18 days and would displace existing Skin Health commitments.

optionName: Defer the maintenance window at current rate
summary: Postpone the maintenance window by four weeks while continuing to run the line at its full rated speed.
rejectionReason: POL-MAINT-002 v2.1 permits zero deferral days when the sustained peak rate exceeds 95 percent of rated speed. Deferring at full rate is a policy violation, not a trade-off.

optionName: Reduced-rate higher-utilisation plan with policy-permitted deferral
summary: Run PKG-02 at 90 percent rate and 90 percent utilisation for the whole campaign, which raises output and lowers stress accrual, and defer maintenance by the 28 days the policy permits at that sustained rate.
materialsConstraint: Requires 14 percent additional pump-cap and carton supply across the campaign; supplier confirmed on 2026-07-31.
